notes.title: Content Update 14/02
September Update
Update 15/06
notes.notes:
[h1]New Equipment: Amulet[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Mystic Dimension bosses have a chance of dropping Amulets when defeated;
    [*]Amulets can grant set bonus for adventure team. Team bonus is activated when party members equip required set of pieces.
    [*]Amulets can be upgraded up to 100 levels: each level-up increases main attribute and has 50% chance of rolling an additional attribute. In addition, every 10 level-ups creates an additional special effect.
[/list]

[h1]Adventure Energy Points[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Adventure Energy Points replaces Adventure Time Restriction in previous version;
    [*]1 Energy Point is consumed for every adventurer turn action, and 2 Energy Points are consumed for every tactic cast;
    [*]Healers can increase 15% total Energy Points per unit, and support units can increase 10% total Energy Points per unit;
    [*]When Energy Points reach 0, adventure fails.
[/list]

[h1]High Level Mystic Dimension[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Mystic Dimension levels are now endless;
    [*]Monsters in higher levels have higher battle stats.
[/list]

[h1]Additional Changes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Completing Mystic Dimension levels can now refresh the Inn.
    [*]It is possible to define minimum Growth Potential for adventurers auto-hire.
    [*]Fixed description for Warrior’s Sunder: reduces target’s All Resistances by 25%
    [*]UI optimization and bug fixes. 
[/list]

notes.title: Update 24/05
notes.notes:
[list]
    [*]Scroll of Tactics: removed 100% rage cost. Now each tactic cast increases rage cost by 30%, up to 90%. This effect gets reset (back to 0%) at start of each battle.
    [*]Fixed a bug that caused rage cost value displayed incorrectly in Adventurer Panel.
    [*]Scroll of Bun: trigger condition has been adjusted to ‘whenever friendly unit kills an enemy unit’.
    [*]Scroll of Summoner: instead of resisting negative effects and having spirits consumed, now each spirit increases 10% Effect Resistance Rating.
    [*]Scroll of Arcane: in addition to existing effect, Drunk Reader’s damage dealt now ignores targets’ Resilience by 50%;
    [*]Scroll of Blade: trigger condition has been adjusted to ‘whenever Red Horn kills an enemy unit’.
    [*]Added new scroll: Scroll of Ghost (Young Warlock exclusive)
    [*]Added new Night Blade exclusive star effect: Demon of the Night, has a chance to be generated from level 8 and above melee armors and weapons.
    [*]Added new Chubby Lady exclusive star effect: Hold On!, has a chance to be generated from level 8 and above melee armors and weapons.
    [*]Added new consumable: Magic Bread.
    [*]Optimized shop UI;  
 [*]Added tactic free cast indication;
    [*]Removed dungeon effect ‘Ghosting’ from Mystic Dimension;
    [*]Adjusted Knight contribution: now grants contribution for Practice Points boost and Chest boost. (Effective for newly generated Knight only)
    [*]Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Talent Tier 3[/h1]

1.	Every adventurer has 5 additional tier 3 talents to choose from;
2.	Players can spend up to 3 talent points on tier 3 talents;
3.	Talent points are reset for all adventurers.


[h1]Scroll Changes[/h1]

1.	Added 6 new class-exclusive scrolls;
2.	Now all scrolls have 1 All Color Socket;
3.	Increased drop rate for Star scrolls.


[h1]Other Changes[/h1]

1.	Added 3 new star effects, possible on all lv.8+ equipment.
2.	Added battle log for unit kills: it is possible to view damage logs on unit kills.
3.	Added damage meter: it is possible to view adventurers total damage done during adventures.
4.	Minor UI optimizations and bug fixes.  
5.	Fire Seed: now fire seed damage is restricted to 1500% of caster’s output capacity from equipment, changed from 1000% of caster’s output capacity.
6.	Element Master effect in Mystic Dimension: now changed to ‘1 shield that immune to all elemental damages’, from ‘7 Shields each immune to 1 individual element’.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Added Town Event System[/h1]

1.	Players can run town events, and each event grants exclusive benefits for the town.
2.	Running events uses policy points and consumes money/practice points every day.
3.	Running events increases residents’ happiness. When happiness reaches 100 the resident will contribute extra effects for the town.
4.	Residents may lose interests for certain events if they have recently participated in them.
5.	Added new consumables produced by town events.

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]

1.	Added Adventurer Rating, and it is easier to spot growth potential differences for adventurers of the same class and quality.
2.	Optimized town stats display.
3.	Added ancient adventurers auto-hire.
4.	Added auto-exploration.
5.	Optimized Adventurer Panel.
6.	It is no longer possible to have gems with both intelligence and strength.
7.	‘Commandment of Spell’ effect enhanced:  At the start of each battle, acquires 8% of friendly members' strength as wearer's agility. Increased from 3%.
8.	Added new gem: Evil Heart
9.	Increased Mystic Dimension maximum level to 500.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Talent System[/h1]

1.	Talent system is added, and players can now spend talent points to further customize adventurers
2.	There are 4 talent tiers, and tier 3 and tier 4 will be released in future versions.


[h1]Gem Adjustments[/h1]

1.	Gem attribute value generation is now more stabilized.
2.	Gems with 3 and 4 attributes now have higher attribute values.
3.	Adjusted attribute pool for gem generations, removed individual resistances and added all resistances.
4.	Added new gem: Commandment of Spell, and it is droppable from Mystic Dimension and the last 30 levels of all maps in Hard Mode.


[h1]Itemization Adjustments[/h1]

1.	Removed individual resistances from all recipes;
2.	Now attribute ‘All Resistance’ will replace all individual resistances for new items generated;
3.	Star effect ‘Confident Healer’ now is restricted to staff and robe only.
4.	‘Suffer-less’ will now appear as star effect on items of lv.12 and higher;
5.	Added new star effect ‘Sacrifice’ for lv.11+ items.


[h1]Other Changes[/h1]

1.	Reduced Negative Effect Reduction Rate on bosses and mini-bosses.
2.	Now items of higher levels have a chance of producing multiple Fragment of Demon when dissembled.
3.	Optimized crafting interface.
4.	Adjusted accessory prices.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Gem Adjustments[/h1]
1.	‘Spirit of the Dead General’ set bonus (4) has been changed to: increase all resistances by 20% whenever kills an enemy, up to 100%. This effect cannot be dispelled and lasts per adventure.
2.	‘Bone of Rapture’ set bonus (4) has been changed to: increase 50% vitality.
3.	‘God’s Moral’ set bonus (4) has been changed to: If not attacked for 3 seconds, agility is increased by 80%.
4.	‘Flying Feather’ set bonus (4) has been changed to: reduces all damage taken by 60% when carrying Heal over Time effects.
5.	Added new gems: Eye of Precision, and Stone of Exorcism  (Drop from Mystic Dimension or the last 30 levels of all maps in Hard Mode).


[h1]Upgrade Card Adjustments[/h1]
1.	Removed Resistance Boost and Taunt Boost upgrade cards;
2.	Added Vitality and Stun upgrade card;
3.	Changed ‘Revenge’ to ‘Absorption’: this card no longer provides Damage Reflection boost as it conflicts with Damage Absorption Shield’s mechanic (shielded units cannot trigger reflection).
4.	All changes won’t affect existing cards.


[h1]Mystic Dimension Added![/h1]
1.	After obtaining ‘Salvation of Heaven’ title in Hard Mode, Mystic Dimension map is unlocked.
2.	Purchasing Mystic Key to get access into Mystic Dimension, key will be consumed for each access.
3.	Adventure in Mystic Dimension has a time limit and fail to complete it before time elapses results in failed adventure.
4.	All monsters in Mystic Dimension have Hit Rage Adjustment and Dodge Rate Adjustment attributes.
5.	Battle encounters in Mystic Dimension are either mini boss groups or boss groups regular minion groups are not spawned.
6.	Mystic Dimension drops lv. 11+ equipment, and lv.10+ gems, and completing levels also unlock relevant recipe levels.
7.	Mystic Dimension drops ‘Ash of Hope’, which can be used to purchase advanced materials/packs in shop.
8.	Mystic Dimension currently have 300 total levels, and related achievements will be added soon.


[h1]Other Adjustments[/h1]
1.	Increased all maps' maximum levels, this means the highest town title can be obtained. In addition, easy mode maps can drop lv.8 gems and lv.9 equipment, and hard mode maps can drop lv.10 gems and lv.11 equipment in high map levels.
2.	Killer’s tactic is enhanced: now dispels 1 positive effects from all targets prior dealing damages.
3.	Soul Thief’s tactic is enhanced: in addition to confusing targets, if targets are already confused/stunned it will dispel 3 positive effects instead.
4.	Passive skill Stamina is changed to: increase damage reduction rate.
5.	Fixed a bug that causes star effect ‘direct heals grant heals over time’ not effective when targets are already at full health.
6.	Reduced Poison Bait’s volumes and damages.
7.	Now item effect ‘Taunt Recover’ is only possible to spawn on plates and swords.
8.	Improved item system, and now should have significantly reduced performance overhead for batching operations.
9.	Increased all currency limit to 500000000.
10.	Lv.11 equipment has a chance of rolling Hit Rate Adjustment and Dodge Rate Adjustment attributes.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
[h1]New Content[/h1]
1.	Added new quest line ‘Thugs’ and 'Nameless Rebels', triggered upon completion of any overseas exploration.
2.	Added new map ‘Northern Territory’
3.	Added new equipment type: Scrolls (unlocks after completing new quest). Scrolls can be created in the School. Scrolls have quality of either Ancient or Star-Ancient. Star-Ancient scrolls have unique star effects, and 1 additional socket. Moreover, all scrolls can have additional effects transferred from other equipment (this can be done in Furnace).
4.	Added ‘Decomposition’ feature for Furnace (unlocks after completing new quest): lv.8+ ancient equipment can be decomposed into Fragments of Demon, and lv.7+ gems can be decomposed into Infused Powder.
5.	Added ‘Transfer’ feature for Furnace (unlocks after completing new quest 'Nameless Rebels'): players can transfer item effects from any lv.8 weapons/armors to a scroll. 
6.	Added ‘Scroll Creation’ feature for School: scroll creation requires Fragments of Demon, Infused Powder, Book Pages, and special materials from all maps (e.g. Crystal of Wooden Forest, Ink of Mist Forest, Ice of Snow Mountain, Seal of Buried Temple, Stone of Hellish Path, Leaf of Imperial Mausoleum and Sand of Northern Territory). Map specific materials can drop from all levels/difficulties after completing the new quest line. Higher difficulty levels/settings have higher drop rate.
7.	Added new adventurer class: Conjurer. Invitations can be found in all levels of ‘Northern Territory’.
8.	Added 50 extra levels for all maps, and unlocked crafting for high level equipment.
9.	Enabled level 3 exploration boat, unlocks when town title at or above ‘Formless Hope’.
10.	Added new adventurer attribute: effect mastery.

[h1]Adjustments[/h1]
1.	Decreased production time for lv.8+ equipment.
2.	Adjusted production requirements for lv.2 and lv.3 exploration boats, low level materials are removed.
3.	Increased Taunt on Hit lasting time to 2 seconds;
4.	Tactic: Curse of Blood, now boosts speed and output capacity, instead of speed and life-on-hit.
5.	Fire seed: lasting time is now 6 seconds instead of 2 turns.
6.	Physical, ice and divine damage effects: de-buffs now last 6 seconds instead of 2 turns.
7.	Poison damage effect: in addition to 3 seconds bleeding, poison damage now can reduce targets heal effectiveness up to 50% for 10 seconds.
8.	Attribute replacement effect: now lasts 4 seconds instead of 1 turn.
9.	Attribute stolen effect: now lasts 4 seconds instead of 1 turn.
10.	Burning Heart de-buff: lasts 4 seconds instead of 1 turn. 
11.	Corrupted Strength de-buff: lasts 4 seconds instead of 1 turn.
12.	Roar de-buff: lasts 6 seconds instead of 2 turns.
13.	God Seed de-buff: lasts 6 seconds instead of 2 turns.
14.	Boss negative resistance mechanic adjustment: boss will receive at least 1 turn for all turn-based negative effects.
15.	‘Skill Rage’ attribute has been changed to ‘Rage Efficiency’: directly reduces rage cost for tactics.
16.	‘Defense Rage’ has been changed to ‘Heal Absorption’, converts potions of direct heals received into damage absorb shield.
17.	All robes now have an additional +10% intelligence attribute.
18.	All leathers now have an additional +10% strength attribute.
19.	Quest ‘Remnants’ now lasts 20 days, increased from 15 days.
20.	Increased drop rate of Star-Ancient items in furnace combine.
21.	Reduced combine cost to 50000.
22.	Added auto-adventure.

notes.title: Update 08/02
notes.notes:
Hi guys, new content has been released:)

PLEASE DON'T FORGET TO BACKUP YOUR SAVE JUST IN CASE


1.	Enabled 5-man battle.
2.	Added new dungeon: Imperial Mausoleum. Imperial Mausoleum is unlocked when you have completed all main quests.
3.	Inside Imperial Mausoleum, speed is reduced by 40% for both adventurers and enemies.
4.	Imperial Mausoleum will drop new materials for crafting level 8 and above items. 
5.	At level 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50, boss is guaranteed to drop new Ancient Star item when you kill them for the first time.
6.	Added new adventurer class: Tactician. Invitation can be dropped from bosses on 30+ levels of Imperial Mausoleum.
7.	When you have earned Salvation of Heaven title, all your existing recipes will have their level 8 version available for production, and you may craft level 8 items within weapon and armor shop.
8.	For level 8 and above items, whenever an ancient grade is produced, dropped or combined, there is a chance of getting a Star version of the item. 
9.	For level 8 and above items, they can be rolled with a random Special Effect when a legendary or above quality is produced.
10.	Star Ancient item will have additional exclusive Star effects attached.
11.	Added level 6 gems;
12.	Combining level 8 and above items will cost money;
13.	Added a new enemy mechanic – Stone Totem, they are real time units and will not use turn progress for their actions in battle.
14.	Adjusted Bun Sister’s tactic.
15.	Adjusted game difficulty levels for early game, to support 5-man battle system
16.	Random bug fixes and UI optimizations.


Please be aware that this new dungeon can be quite challenging :)
Cheers!

notes.title: Update 03/02
New Adventurers and Difficulty Changes
Development Update: Early Access Release Date Confirmed, Forge System Added
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31285895/a40d313de9a9b880132bde2c0a547c669090ce87.gif[/img]

We are planning to release Dragon Cliff in Early Access on 30th Jan (PST). EA is expected to run for 1-3 months. This will allow eager players to have access of Dragon Cliff as soon as possible, at the same time also give us opportunities to work with community to further polish and improve game experiences. During EA, we will be reachable via forum and emails, feel free to throw us any criticisms and feedbacks XD

Additionally, we have implemented a forge system during our latest development, and this should further complete Dragon Cliff’s itemization. By using forge, gears can be dissembled into dusts or combined into an upgraded quality. High quality gears generally have more gem slots, and hence allows good gem sets to be embedded. Gem sets may grant unique battle effects, and can enable a lot of combat strategies.

Looking forward to 30th Jan!
